Corollary
[cone of nonnegative tensors] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0040 ↗ lem:chow-ii-spectral-invariance 1. ch10:10.12\group Bundle maximum principles

The cone of self-adjoint tensors with all eigenvalues nonnegative is parallel invariant.
Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:chow-ii-spectral-invariance Use $G(\lambda )=-\min _a\lambda _a$ in the spectral criterion.

□
